title: Transfection of Primary Endothelial Cells with siRNA
author: Thomas Mudersbach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xtqfnmw

steps.title: Seed Endothelial Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells the day before transfection at a density of 3 x 10^4 cells/cm².

steps.title: Wash and Starve Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for transfection by washing and serum starvation.

substeps.instruction: Starve cells for at least 2 hours in 500 µL serum-free basal MCDB131 Medium at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the siRNA and Lipofectamine RNAiMax complexes (volumes for a single well of a 12-well plate).

substeps.instruction: In tube A, add 1.5 µL of siRNA (50 pmol stock) to 125 µL Opti-MEM.
In tube B, add 3.75 µL of Lipofectamine RNAiMax into 125 µL Opti-MEM.
Mix each tube gently and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add the siRNA solution from tube A to the lipofectamine solution in tube B and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Transfection
steps.instruction: Apply the transfection complex to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 225 µL of the siRNA/lipofectamine solution to each well.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Incubation and Harvest
steps.instruction: Incubate cells and prepare for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Change the medium to endothelial cell growth medium 4 to 6 hours after transfection.
Incubate the endothelial cells for 48 hours at 37 °C.
Wash cells with PBS and snap freeze in liquid nitrogen for further analysis.
